sound.detail: Draft contains short character-style lines about new worlds, friendship, disappearing, secrets, waiting, land and power. These support genre mood rather than explain the app. The closing draft is partly garbled. No voice delivery, music or effects were heard.
sound.visual_relation: V01–V09; precise dialogue and edit alignment unverified.

categories.finding: Series montage → launch promise → phone catalog → brand.
Huge TRUESHORT letters cover a snowy arch landscape with tiny figures; the opening offers scale and mystery.
The viewer sees an entertainment slate early, but the app becomes clear only near 66s.
Characters and vehicles change pose and position; phone framing changes the scale of footage near the end. Exact paths/easing are unresolved.
Repeated title placement connects otherwise unrelated genres; the phone reveal links the montage to a product.
Snow, metal, fur, rain, warm rooms and dark space distinguish the worlds.
Series names and NEW SERIES labels classify scenes; the later large launch words explain no concrete format difference.
Draft dialogue gives each genre a short story cue; delivery and all acoustic qualities remain unknown.
Music character and structure are unverified.
Effects and their sources are unverified.

categories.finding: Silent viewing conveys genres and a catalog; the new-format promise remains vague.
Stable series names anchor changing imagery, then the phone becomes the central object.
Each title gets roughly 6–8s and several shots; the catalog receives much less time than the fiction.
The opening brand/world montage pays off as a slate; the claim of a new type of entertainment lacks a concrete example.
The succession of friendship, romance, danger and power appears designed to offer genre choice; audience response is unmeasured.
categories.reason: Interpretation from pictures and draft words.

categories.finding: Title labels preserve local continuity; the phone catalog finally gives the worlds a shared home.
The film shows preview material and an app view. AI production, revenue, availability and catalog functionality are not established by these images.
Named series and the recurring wordmark make the slate specific, while the large launch wording is generic.
Add one viewing interaction to explain the new format.
